verdict.rationale: Disputes are a fair question for a card-issuing and ACH banking-as-a-service platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers dispute handling, Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, or documented ops responsibilities. The only related items are general card issuing, ACH payments, and dashboard data access, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, card and ACH disputes are handled properly — Reg E investigation timelines, provisional credit mechanics, and my operational responsibilities documented and tooled
